description:
Navigate to the 'Give Change' activity in GCompris (under Math/Arithmetic > Money). In this activity, you must calculate the change to return to a customer (Amount Paid - Price). Complete 5 rounds of transactions. 

Documentation Requirements:
1. Take a screenshot during a transaction showing the Price and Paid values. Save it to '~/Documents/change_giving_ui.png'.
2. After completing the 5th round (when the mascot/success animation appears), take a final screenshot. Save it to '~/Documents/task_complete.png'.
